pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: world current affairs (Honduras president)
garbled: stem has unrelated note text about Nepal PMs pasted in
wrong topic: new Parliament building architect (national current affairs)
wrong topic: regional groupings (Mekong Ganga Cooperation)
wrong topic: evacuation operations (Operation Ganga, Ukraine)

patterns: Direct one-liners on neighbour events: Myanmar coup (Feb 2021), first PM of Republic of Nepal (Prachanda), countries banning LTTE.
Project-country matching (Mangdechhu-Bhutan, Kaladan-Myanmar, Salma Dam-Afghanistan) appears in APPSC and UPSC.
LBA/100th Amendment enclave counts (111 Indian to Bangladesh, 51 to India) and Katchatheevu/Tin Bigha are classic traps.
APPSC mixes in current-affairs one-liners (DTAA with Sri Lanka) rather than multi-statement items; app uses many 3-4 statement questions.
